metaDescription: Order custom 16 oz wine tumblers for your next event. Perfect for bulk branding. Get a quote today!
introHtml: For events where guests want a full pour without constant refills, custom 16 oz wine tumblers hit the sweet spot. Larger than standard 12 oz glasses but still comfortable to hold, this size works well for trade shows, corporate parties, and fundraising galas. The 16 oz Govino® Wine Glass is a popular choice, offering shatterproof durability for outdoor venues. Decorate with screen printing or embossing to keep your logo visible throughout the event.
heroAltText: Custom 16 oz wine tumblers with screen printed logos, ideal for corporate events and bulk orders
